title: Welcome to Intake
text: MEMO: Welcome to Intake. Nobody currently on staff knows where the outgoing tray leads. Please continue stamping.

title: A Familiar Feeling
text: MEMO: Mortal realm reporting a spike in déjà vu. Statistically correlated with our throughput. Statistically ignored.

title: Heaven at Capacity
text: NOTICE: Heaven is now open for business and, as of this morning, already at 97% capacity. Please stamp accordingly.

title: A Filing Discrepancy
text: INCIDENT: Soul #4471 was filed as both 'cat' and 'CEO' in the same fiscal quarter. Investigating which form was correct, if either.

title: Hell Organises
text: MEMO: Hell's imps have unionised. Their first demand is two breaks per eternity. Management is 'reviewing the concept of eternity.'

title: Signed, Not Read
text: AUDIT FLAG: The Auditor signed this year's report without reading it. The report was, itself, about the Auditor not reading reports.

title: Somehow
text: MEMO: Throughput is up. Headcount is down. Nobody can explain 'somehow,' and Legal has asked us to stop writing it in memos.

title: Staffing, Reimagined
text: NOTICE: Staffing is now conducted via a sealed requisition pool. HR insists on calling this 'engagement' rather than 'a lottery.'

title: The Years Shrink
text: MEMO: Fiscal years are getting shorter. Nobody has approved this. Nobody has explained it. The audits keep coming faster.

title: The Wheel Turns
text: MEMO: The Wheel of Reincarnation has a persistent squeak. Maintenance says it is 'structural' and 'part of the process now.'

title: A Pattern Noted
text: MEMO: Legal has flagged your attendance record as 'suspiciously reliable.' No action required. Just noted. Watched, even.

title: One Tuesday, Shared
text: INCIDENT: Two unrelated souls have filed the exact same memory of a Tuesday. Filing under 'coincidence' pending further review.

title: A Question, Finally
text: AUDIT FLAG: The Auditor asked a question this year. Nobody was prepared. The meeting has been rescheduled indefinitely.

title: Box Seven
text: NOTICE: Limbo's Lost & Found has located Box 7. Contents remain classified. The Registrar is, for once, smiling.

title: A Surplus of Dave
text: MEMO: The personnel roster currently lists three separate Daves. All three insist they are the original. All three are correct.

title: Eternity, Quantified
text: MEMO: Eternity is now a tracked KPI. It is trending upward, which management considers both impossible and satisfactory.

title: A Brief Lapse
text: INCIDENT: Gravity was briefly optional across three departments. Facilities has confirmed it is optional no longer. Mostly.

title: One Form Remains
text: AUDIT FLAG: The fruit basket has been searched. It contains exactly one unstamped form, and the form has your name on it.

title: Purpose, Returned
text: NOTICE: Lost & Found has returned a sense of purpose to the front desk. Nobody has claimed it. It is available for pickup.

title: The Backlog Notices
text: MEMO: The backlog has reportedly begun noticing individual clerks by name. Management assures staff this is 'not concerning.'

title: The Queue, Unassisted
text: INCIDENT: The intake queue has begun stamping itself. Staff are asked not to interfere, and also not to take credit.

title: The Auditor, Unbribed
text: AUDIT FLAG: The Auditor, newly unbribed, has filed a report. The subject of the report is you. It is, regrettably, accurate.

title: HR Declares Victory
text: NOTICE: HR has declared the staffing crisis resolved and closed the department. Nobody is sure who will process this notice.

title: A Discussion, Ongoing
text: MEMO: 'Cosmic Restructuring' is officially 'being discussed.' The discussion has itself been added to the fiscal calendar.

title: Pre-Approved
text: NOTICE: Incoming souls now arrive pre-approved. The stamping is, at this point, largely ceremonial. Please continue anyway.

title: Into the Tray
text: MEMO: The Auditor has retired. Into the tray. The tray has been relabeled 'Office of the Auditor' out of respect.

title: The Realm Takes Notes
text: MEMO: The mortal realm has noticed a pattern in your attendance. Several religions have opened a comment thread about it.

title: The Department, Entire
text: NOTICE: This department is, as of this filing, functionally the entire afterlife. Please update your business cards accordingly.

title: They Will Be in Touch
text: MEMO: 'Cosmic Restructuring' will be in touch. No further details available. The calendar has stopped taking new entries.

title: Your Name, on the Stamp
text: AUDIT FLAG: The stamp has, at some point, acquired your name. Nobody remembers engraving it. It works better than ever.
